## 1. Before asking for help

- Check the installed version: `npm ls @flipova/foundation`.
- See the paths resolved by the tool: `npx flipova-design where`.
- Search the problems already reported: https://github.com/flipova/foundation/issues

## 2. Common problems

| **Symptom** | **Likely cause** | **Solution** |
|--------------|--------------------|--------------|
| `gen --check` fails | A generated file no longer matches the registries. | Run `npx flipova-design gen` and commit the files it produces. |
| "missing role" at startup | Your theme lacks one of the 27 required color roles. | Add the role in the Themes tab of the graphical interface or in `themes.xml`. |
| Tamagui rejects a token name | `true` or `none` are reserved. | The adapter renames `none` to `zero`; use that name on the tamagui side. |
| A component does not look like the chosen library | That library does not provide it, so it is served by flipova. | Check the coverage with `coverageOf(adaptateur)` or `COMPONENTS.md`. |
| Module not found (`react-native-paper`…) | The provider's optional dependency is not installed. | Install it with npm. |

## 3. Frequently asked questions

**Do I have to install all the libraries?**

No. Only flipova is included; each other library is an optional dependency, required only if you choose its provider.

**Can I change provider later?**

Yes. The component properties are identical; you only need to change the adapter passed to `FlipovaProvider`.

**Where is my theme?**

In the `design/` folder of your application (four XML files). The package only provides a neutral starting point.

**Does the package work on the web?**

The flipova provider targets React Native. The tests run with react-native-web, but rendering on a device is not verified.

## 4. Getting help

Open an issue including: the package version, your system, the command you ran and its full output.

Report a problem: https://github.com/flipova/foundation/issues
